mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS totalExpense, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT category AS category, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC
